selected_evidence.summary: Installed both modprobe rules, rebuilt initramfs, and proved usb_storage remained unloaded after a rejected load attempt.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, the persistent rules were active; usb_storage was absent before and after a rejected load attempt.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were observed before and after the change.

Baseline boot ID a9593011-3617-4b72-8b02-2e8a4d2b17a3 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID 05e3c811-ee5f-426a-91f8-36a8028a8ce6 proved the restart. Post-restart system state was running, root storage was writable, and module blocking remained effective.
